Hi David / Elena,

Thanks again — excited to run the exec workshop at Cordova next week (Oct 12). To make door access smooth I've attached the pre-registration badging form and a short visitor SOP we use for executive-level workshops. A couple of high-level items up front: 

- Badge pickup: We recommend a single pickup window (08:30–09:15) at Building A lobby; badges are returned at the end of day at the concierge desk.
- ID: Government-issued photo ID required for all guests; we can pre-populate names on the badge form to speed pickup.
- Escort policy: For any guest without a company-issued badge, Cordova's escort policy applies — Redwood will provide two liaisons (monica + alex) to escort Redwood staff and guests between rooms.
- Device/network: Guest machines must go on the guest SSID. If any attendees need VPN access to a demo environment, we need an approved temporary account request 72 hours prior.

Please review the attached site_badging_form.pdf and return completed names + any special access flags by EOD Tues (Oct 6). If Cordova security prefers, we can have security@cordovabio.com handle badge printing directly — let me know.

Attachments: [attachment: site_badging_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Soojim Lee

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the checklist. Quick follow-ups from Cordova security: 

1) Badge return vs. reuse: Do Redwood attendees keep badges after the workshop or must they be turned in at concierge? We prefer turn-in for contractor badges.
2) Visitor photo policy: We saw the form requests a photo. Are you collecting photos centrally or will guests bring printed photos / use onsite kiosk?
3) Laptops: Any Redwood engineers bringing demo laptops that will require access to Cordova internal network? We need a list to raise firewall exceptions / temporary accounts.

Also looping in our security ops (security@cordovabio.com) — Catherine from ops prefers to confirm escort windows and a point-of-contact for the counter.
